subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only plugin hooks for reaction add/remove events, and should the initial implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but this adds a public plugin API surface whose hook names, payload, privacy gates, and overlap with inbound-event/wake work need maintainer direction before a safe implementation.

options.title: Approve Generic Reaction Hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only plugin hooks, start with Discord behind existing reaction notification gates, and document the cross-channel payload contract.

options.title: Route Through Broader Inbound Events
options.body: Defer this specific hook until the broader inbound non-message event API in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100447 or related PR work defines the canonical contract.

options.title: Keep System Events Only
options.body: Leave reactions as passive system events for now and close or defer plugin-specific reaction automation until a stronger maintainer-sponsored use case appears.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Reaction Hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only plugin hooks, start with Discord behind existing reaction notification gates, and document the cross-channel payload contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Discord reaction path and plugin/runtime API surfaces, making him the best available owner for the API direction choice.
